description: Deterministic entry plus a pure, in-memory review20 staging contract. Candidate mutation, model invocation and result publication are not enabled in this version.

invocation.ui: The same structured object, with expectedRevisionId supplied by the UI.
invocation.project: Required from the selected host project (mls.actualProject), never inferred from stored modules.
invocation.invalidInput: A status-only task with root LLM skipped; no source or candidate write.

executableSteps.goal: Freeze the explicit project, module, base, change, revision and request after validating both folder references and all source hashes.

privateStages.goal: Compare candidate against the base and stage only policy-qualified scalar replacements or a clarification; no filesystem writes or approval.
Validate an assembled proposal with caller-supplied real context while observing, but never consuming, the persisted correction counter; unsupported candidates remain drafts.

reservedNotScheduled.reason: The pure core exists, but no step intent obtains the structured model response; orchestration and shared-run gates are not enabled.
Dependency reconciliation is not implemented yet.
The pure core consumes mr_03a coverage, but reconcile30 and a step/orchestrator are not implemented.
Requires conditional publication from mr_00; never uses local-only locks as a global CAS.

safety: No LLM call, candidate write, original write, materializer or planner dispatch occurs in entry10 or private review20 staging.
A missing or stale active revision is a refusal, not an implicit snapshot rewrite.
This flow does not report an accepted review or completed release.
